verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is an integration and automation tooling product, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only managed auth, MCP tool calling, transports, SDKs and environments. Nothing documents version history, change review, or rollback for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
